item.title: Carney signs defence, trade agreement with Japan in final stop of 10-day trip
item.description: TOKYO — Canada and Japan have signed a new strategic partnership agreement that looks to boost co-operation on defence, energy, trade and technology.

item.title: Plane that crashed in Maine spent more time on runway than recommended after deicing, NTSB says
item.description: PORTLAND, Maine (AP) — A private jet that crashed in Maine in January, killing all six people aboard, remained on the ground 8 minutes longer than it should have after receiving a deicing treatment in a snowstorm, according to a preliminary report

item.description: Anyone with information is asked to call Sault Police

item.title: Mother of B.C. mass shooting survivor shares update, says breathing tube removed
item.description: The mother of a 12-year-old girl critically injured in the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., last month says her daughter's breathing tube has been removed as doctors check to see whether she can breathe on her own.

item.title: Carney calls for Mountbatten-Windsor's removal from line of succession
item.description: TOKYO — Prime Minister Mark Carney says Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor should be removed from the royal line of succession for his "deplorable" actions.

item.title: Anand: U.S., Israel have 'no blank cheque' in Iran and are bound by international law
item.description: OTTAWA — The United States and Israel do not have a "blank cheque" in their bombing campaign in Iran and are still bound by international law, Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand said Friday as the war approached the seven-day mark.

item.title: A year after HBC's collapse, some reimagined spaces — and a lot of vacant stores
item.description: Four days before Christmas, shoppers lined up around the Bay Centre in Victoria, B.C., where a corner of the mall had been transformed into a scene reminiscent of a London high street.

item.title: Greyhounds shut out as Rangers ride defence to win
item.description: A parade to the penalty box left the Soo Greyhounds chasing the game Friday night. Despite killing off every Kitchener power play, a shorthanded goal and a lack of offence played a role in the setback

item.title: 4 dead in Michigan as powerful storms that produced at least 1 tornado rip through the state
item.description: Four people were killed Friday in southern Michigan as powerful storms that produced at least one tornado reduced homes to rubble, sent parts of roofs flying into the air and left a trail of debris hanging from power lines.
